title: Name hypotheses by binders and close resolutions with resolve_right
summary: Shrinks the Lean text generated for Z3 proof certificates by naming hypotheses by their binders and closing unit resolutions with Or.resolve_right instead of Or.elim case splits. QF_IDL plan-21 drops from 25.5 to 23.4 MB and verifies at a 7.0 GB peak, while two larger benchmarks still exceed the 8 GB cap.
